## Summary
Sprint 1 token budget (5,000,000) was exhausted after delivering the technical foundation documentation story. The team successfully completed US-0001 (Accepted), establishing comprehensive tech stack documentation (Python/Flask), persistence strategy, and project setup. The sprint's ambitious backlog of 12 stories proved unrealistic within budget constraints. Only 1 of 12 planned stories reached Accepted. Core retrospective finding: initial story estimates significantly underestimated token consumption for implementation work. Future sprints must re-baseline all remaining stories and reduce scope to fit revised budget projections with safety margin. The partial sprint goal (establish technical foundation) was achieved for documentation; additional technical foundation and API implementation work carries forward to Sprint 2.
